blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.
blocks.zh: 在生产系统中,由点,线,三角等原始物来代表3D几何,因为渲染硬件被优化,从中产生非常高效的图像. 通过体积渲染从图像中学习这种原始物是具有挑战性的,因为它们是在空间中无限地点界定的地拉克质量。 EWA花板,波森重建,和3D高斯花板通过将Dirac大众与低频内核联合起来来克服这个现象,这种配方沿两个轴线进行概括:内核和原始. 由于点和三角已经受到很大关注, 我们调查这种菜谱 对于曲边原始人, 并引入意大利面板。 我们通过聚线来大致的曲线, 聚线的演化与连续曲线的演化, 体积使每个分段都成形, 这样连接的分段复合, 而不在它们的关节上过量计算。 为了快速的训练和推论,我们把相机投影每段线性化,它也容纳了高斯人以外的内核,例如Beta内核. 由于一个点是一个零长度的曲线,我们的代表是一个严格地超集的3D高斯平板. 它在一般场景上仍然具有与最先进的竞争能力,优于专用于线状几何学的方法,本土支持反变相,并产生可直接被物理模拟所接受的长相相接的线条.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In production graphics systems, 3D geometry is represented by points, lines, and triangles ( i.e . , primitives ), as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently.
Rather than constructing them by hand, we would like to optimize such primitives directly from a collection of images, by volume rendering [ 21 ] and gradient descent.
However, this is challenging, as primitives are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space, so there is nothing for a gradient to act on.
blocks.zh:
在生产图形系统中,3D几何以点,线,三角形(即原始的)为代表,因为渲染硬件被优化,从中生成图像的效率非常高.
与其用手建构它们,不如直接从图像集合中,通过体积渲染[21]和梯度下降来优化这种原始物。
然而,这是具有挑战性的,因为原始人是在空间中无限位置定义的迪拉克质量,因此没有梯度可以采取行动。

blocks.en:
Research from about two decades ago showed us how to overcome this.
EWA splatting [ 46 ] and Poisson reconstruction [ 12 ] both turn a Dirac-like representation into a volumetric one by convolving it with a low-frequency kernel.
This makes sampling the representation onto a discrete grid of pixels well posed from the perspective of the Nyquist–Shannon theorem [ 41 ] .
3D Gaussian Splatting [ 13 ] uses this idea to differentiate through point-like primitives, which it convolves with anisotropic Gaussian kernels. But could this idea be generalized?
blocks.zh:
大约20年前的研究告诉我们如何克服这种情况。
EWA电镀[46]和Poisson重建[12]都通过与低频内核结合,将类似Dirac的表示器变成体积1.
这使得从Nyquist-Shannon定理的角度来看,将代表物取样到一个像素的离散网格中[41]。
3D Gaussian Splateting [13] 利用这个想法通过点状的原始物进行区分,它与异形的Gaussian内核交织. 但是,这个想法是否可以被概括?

blocks.en:
To this end, we approximate curves by polylines, and show that their convolution with a kernel converges to that of the continuous curve as the segments shrink.
Whereas the Gaussian convolution of a polygon requires evaluating Owen’s T function [ 26 , 7 ] , the ray integral of a Gaussian-convolved segment only involves the Gauss error function erf \operatorname{erf} ( i.e . , the anti-derivative of a Gaussian).
By volume rendering the density of each segment [ 31 ] , connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints.
For fast training and inference, we follow EWA splatting [ 46 ] and linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates Beta kernels [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
为此,我们通过多线线来近似曲线,并显示它们与内核的演化会随着片段的收缩而与连续曲线的演化趋同.
虽然高斯演化多边形要求评价欧文的T函数[26,7],但高斯演化段的射线组件只涉及高斯误差函数 erf\operatorname{erf}(即高斯文的反衍生).
通过容积渲染每个段的密度[31],连接的段合成而不会在关节上过量计算.
为了快速训练和推论,我们遵循EWA电镀法[46],将相机投影线化,每个片段亦可容纳 Beta内核 [16].

blocks.en:
Our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting, as a point is nothing else than a curve of zero length.
As such, it matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art on Mip-NeRF 360 [ 2 ] , i.e . , Deformable Beta Splatting [ 16 ] for geometry, coupled with Spherical Voronoi [ 29 ] for modeling of view-dependent appearance.
Spaghetti Splatting also outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry: the concurrent work of Tojo et al. [34] on their Fuzzy benchmark, and Gaussian Haircut [ 43 ] , which relies on hair-specific priors, on GeomHair [ 15 ] .
It natively supports Mip-Splatting [ 41 ] anti-aliasing, so it remains stable across viewing distances.
Finally, our representation consists of long connected strands, which makes it amenable to physics simulation, and closer to what an artist would produce.
blocks.zh:
我们的表示是3D高斯白板的严格超组合,因为一个点只不过是零长度的曲线.
因此,它匹配或超过了Mip-NERF 360 [2]上最先进的技术,即:可变形的Beta Platting [16] 用于几何学,与球形Voronoi [29] 用于模拟视线依赖的外观.
意大利面条 镀层还超越了专用于线状几何的方法:Tojo等人同时进行的工作. [34]在他们的Fuzzy基准上,和高斯海尔克特[43],它依赖于特定发型的前身,在GeomHair[15]上.
它在本土上支持Mip-Splateting [41] 反异形,因此在跨视距上保持稳定.
最后,我们的代表包括连接时间很长的线条, 这使得它可以进行物理模拟, 更接近艺术家的制作。

blocks.en: We achieve these results through four key contributions: • We note that the key ingredient behind 3D Gaussian Splatting and Poisson reconstruction, i.e . , convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, provides a recipe that generalizes along both the kernel and the primitive. • We investigate this recipe for curvilinear Dirac masses, and provide a convergent as well as efficient way to back-propagate through them. • We generalize 3D Gaussian Splatting to a strictly larger family of representations, which remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, while setting a new state-of-the-art for strand-based representations. • We commit to fully release code to foster precise comparisons, and follow-up research.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四大贡献来取得这些成果: 我们注意到,3D Gaussian Splateting和Poisson重建背后的关键成分,即将Dirac群与低频内核结合,提供了一种将内核和原始核同时概括的配方. 我们调查这种配方 用于曲折的Dirac质量, 并提供一个趋同和有效的方式 通过它们支持。 • 支助 我们把3D高斯白板化为更广大的代表家庭,在一般场景上仍然与最先进的代表家庭有竞争力,同时为以线条为基础的代表设定一个新的最先进的代表家庭. —— 我们承诺充分发布代码,以促进精确的比较和后续研究。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) represents a scene as a continuous density and color field rendered by numerical integration along camera rays [ 21 ] .
Later neural fields addressed aliasing and unbounded scenes [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , while multiresolution hash encodings substantially reduced their training cost [ 25 ] .
3DGS replaced the neural field with explicit anisotropic Gaussians [ 13 ] , and a tile-based rasterizer derived from point-based volume rendering and EWA splatting [ 46 , 37 ] .
Subsequent methods have improved both its optimization and rendering.
3DGS-MCMC formulates population control as sampling [ 14 ] , and StopThePop introduces per-pixel sorting for more consistent visibility [ 27 ] .
Other methods parallelize the backward pass over Gaussians instead of pixels [ 19 ] , integrate Gaussian density along each ray [ 33 ] , render constant-density ellipsoids in closed form [ 18 ] , or avoid the affine projection used by rasterization [ 22 , 38 ] .
Another line of work replaces the Gaussian kernel: Deformable Beta Splatting (DBS) learns the fall-off of a compact Beta kernel [ 16 ] , while Student Splatting and Scooping uses heavy-tailed kernels with signed weights [ 45 ] .
Mip-Splatting prevents aliasing across viewing distances with a three-dimensional smoothing filter based on the training views and a two-dimensional filter during rasterization [ 41 ] .
Spherical Voronoi replaces spherical harmonics with a learned directional partition [ 29 ] .
We build on several of these improvements and adopt 3DGS-MCMC population control, the Beta kernel of DBS, Mip-Splatting filtering, and Spherical Voronoi appearance modeling.
blocks.zh:
神经辐射场(NERF)代表着一个场景,是一个连续的密度和色彩场,由数字结合沿相机射线产生[21].
后来的神经领域涉及别名和无约束场景[1,2,3],而多分辨率散列编码则大幅降低了他们的训练成本[25].
3DGS用显性异构高斯人[13]取代了神经场,并且从点基的体积渲染和EWA的镀层中衍生出一种基于瓦片的光栅. [46,37].
随后的方法改进了它的优化和渲染.
3DGS-MCMC制定人口控制作为取样[14],停止 ThePop引入了每像素排序,以更加一致的能见度[27].
其他方法将落后的过高斯人比对像素[19],将高斯人密度沿每根射线结合[33],使常密度椭圆形闭合[18],或避免光栅化使用的近缘投影[22,38].
另一行工程取代高斯内核: 可变形的Beta Platting(DBS)学习到一个紧凑的Beta内核的脱落[16],而Scooping学生的Platting和Scooping则使用带有签名重量的重尾核[45].
Mip-Splating防止在光栅化过程中使用基于训练视图的三维平滑滤波器和二维滤波器进行异名穿越视距[41].
球形Voronoi用学习方向分区代替球形口音[29].
在这些改进的基础上,我们采用了3DGS-MCMC人口控制,DBS的Beta内核,Mip-Splating滤波,以及球形Voronoi外观模型.

blocks.en:
Another line of work replaces point centers with extended geometric primitives.
Triangle Splatting [ 11 ] and 3D Convex Splatting [ 9 ] optimize triangles and smooth convex bodies.
Curve primitives have so far targeted sparse abstractions of a scene: 3Doodle optimizes 3D Bézier strokes and superquadric contours to render view-consistent sketches [ 6 ] , while SketchSplat reconstructs parametric 3D edges by splatting Gaussians sampled along curves onto multi-view edge maps [ 40 ] .
The concurrently developed opaque line primitives of Tojo et al. [34] are closely related to our work, as they also use line primitives directly for differentiable rendering.
Their method rasterizes segments on a subpixel grid using the Bresenham algorithm and recovers high-quality geometry in object-centric scenes.
That said, their line primitives are rendered at a constant screen-space width regardless of their depth from the camera, making the representation unsuitable for general scenes, as we show in our comparison on Mip-NeRF 360 ( ).
We include evaluations of our method on the Fuzzy dataset introduced by their work.
blocks.zh:
另一行工作用延伸几何原始物取代点中心.
三角形镀板[11]和3D型凸轮形镀板[9]优化三角形和光滑的凸轮体.
曲面原始人至今已锁定一个场景的稀疏抽象:3Doodle优化了3D Bézier的中风和超夸张的轮廓,以渲染与视图一致的草图[6],而SketchSplat则通过将高斯人沿着曲线取样的参数化3D边缘重建到多视图边缘地图上[40].
同时开发的不透明线原始的Tojo et al. [34]与我们的工作密切相关,因为他们也直接使用线形原始来进行异质渲染.
他们的方法利用布雷森汉姆算法在子像素网格上光栅化片段,并在以物体为中心的场景中恢复高质量的几何.
尽管如此,他们的线性原始是用恒定的屏幕-空间宽度来渲染的,而不论其从相机的深度如何,这使得其表现不适合一般场景,正如我们在比较Mip-NERF 360(......)时所表明的那样。
我们包括对我们通过其工作引入的模糊数据集方法的评估。

blocks.en:
A classical computer graphics technique, Convolution Surfaces [ 4 ] , has shown that one can represent many implicit shapes as an iso-surface of a convolution of a skeleton of curves and polygons with a smooth kernel.
Recently, Xu et al. [39] demonstrated that one can efficiently render a Gaussian process implicit surface as an iso-surface of a sparse convolution of a kernel with randomly placed points.
In both cases, the convolved field serves only to define an iso-surface.
We instead use segment and polyline skeletons convolved with corresponding kernels as an explicit volume-rendering representation which we optimize from multi-view images.
In this view, point-based splatting primitives are a special case of our segments with zero length, and our method maintains their fast rendering speed.
blocks.zh:
一种古典的计算机图形技术Convolution Surfaces [4] 已经表明,一个人可以代表许多隐形的形状,作为曲线和多边形骨架呈平滑内核的演化的异地表.
最近,许等人. [39] 证明可以有效地使高斯过程隐含的表面作为内核的微小演化的同位表面,随机放置点.
在这两种情况下,演化场只能用来定义同位素表面。
相反,我们使用部分和多线骨架与相应的内核交织在一起,作为我们从多视图图像中优化的清晰的量递增表示。
在这种观点下,点基的镀层原始物是我们片段的特例,长度为零,我们的方法保持了它们的快速渲染速度.

blocks.en:
Hair is a prominent example of geometry that is naturally described by curves.
Neural Strands and Neural Haircut reconstruct strand geometry with learned priors [ 28 , 30 ] .
Gaussian Haircut and GaussianHair represent hair with Gaussians aligned to strand directions [ 43 , 17 ] .
Our reconstruction optimizes rooted polylines without a learned strand prior and passes the resulting curves directly to position-based simulation [ 23 , 24 ] .
We use the public strand models from GeomHair [ 15 ] as reference geometry [ 42 ] .

高斯海尔克和高斯海尔克 头发代表头发 高斯人与线圈方向一致 [43, 17].

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We begin by reviewing how a 3D Gaussian can be interpreted as the convolution of a Dirac mass with an anisotropic Gaussian kernel ( Sec. 3.1 ).
We then extend this formulation to Gaussian-convolved line segments ( Sec. 3.2 ) and derive the corresponding closed-form rendering equation ( Sec. 3.3 ).
Finally, we describe fast rendering with EWA splatting ( Sec. 3.4 ), anti-aliasing ( Sec. 3.5 ), and optimization ( Sec. 3.6 ).

我们首先审查如何将3D高斯人解释为带有异构高斯人内核的Dirac质量的演化(第3.1条)。

最后,我们用EWA电镀法(第3.4条)、反变异法(第3.5条)和优化法(第3.6条)描述快速渲染。

blocks.en: 3.4 Efficient rendering
blocks.zh: 3.4 高效渲染

blocks.en:
Evaluating the closed form for every primitive–pixel pair requires extensive computation of ray-dependent quantities, which is too slow for splatting-style training and rendering.
We therefore compute EWA [ 46 ] at the midpoint once per frame and scale it along the segment with inverse depth, which reduces the per-pixel evaluation to a few screen-space quantities.
This allows the kernel to vary in screen space, keeping the 3D shape consistent.
The yellow segment in shows the resulting foreshortening.
We additionally show analysis of our EWA computation in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
评估每对原始-像素的闭合形式需要大量计算依赖射线的数量,这对于镀层式的训练和渲染来说太慢了.
因此,我们将EWA[46]在每帧的中点计算一次,并沿着反向深度的片段进行放大,从而将每像素的评价减少到几个屏幕-空间的数量.
这样可以让内核在屏幕空间中变化,保持3D形状的一致性.

我们还在补充材料中展示了我们对环境、水和水的计算的分析。

blocks.en: 3.5 Anti-aliasing
blocks.zh: 3.5 反盗用

blocks.en:
To avoid aliasing, we follow Mip-Splatting [ 41 ] and apply a 3D as well as a 2D Gaussian filter to our primitives.
The 3D filter band-limits each primitive to the maximal sampling rate of the training views, so that it cannot encode detail the training images cannot resolve.
The 2D filter convolves each projected primitive with a sub-pixel screen-space Gaussian, which prevents primitives that project to less than a pixel from aliasing or flickering.
Under the EWA linearization ( Sec. 3.4 ), both filters simply add to the covariance of the projected kernel along the entire segment, so the closed form still applies.
We thus pre-filter each primitive in closed form, with a single sample per pixel.
In contrast, the concurrent work of Tojo et al. [34] does not support spatial convolutions and must therefore resort to multisample anti-aliasing with four samples per pixel.
blocks.zh:
为了避免化名,我们跟随Mip-Splating [41] 将3D以及2D高斯滤波器应用到我们的原始人身上.
3D滤波带将每个原始限制在训练视图的最大采样率,因此它无法编码详细化训练图像无法解决.
2D滤波器用子像素屏幕-空格高斯琴对每个投射的原始进行曲动,防止投影到小于像素的原始人别名或闪烁.
在EWA线性化(Sec. 3.4 )下,两个滤波器都简单地增加了整个片段的预测内核的共变,所以闭合形式仍然适用.
因此,我们预过滤每个原始的封闭形式,每个像素有一个单一的样本。
相比之下,Tojo等人同时进行的工作. [34]不支持空间演化,因此必须采用每个像素有四个样本的多样反异形.

As in other per-scene optimization methods, we adaptively resample our primitives to allocate representation capacity where it is needed.
Following 3DGS-MCMC [ 14 ] , we prune segments and sample their relocation targets based on opacity.

在3DGS-MCMC[14]之后,我们根据不透明情况对迁移目标进行抽样。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate our primitive through extensive comparisons with a range of baselines on two tasks: novel view synthesis of general scenes ( Sec. 4.1 ) to demonstrate how this representation is a generalization of 3DGS, and reconstruction of hair strands from images ( Sec. 4.2 ) to demonstrate its effectiveness its in-domain setting.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在两个任务上与一系列基线进行广泛的比较来评价我们的原始性:新视角合成一般场景(第4.1节),以显示这种表现如何是3DGS的概括,以及从图像中重建毛线(第4.2节),以显示其内域环境的有效性。

blocks.en: 4.1 General scenes
blocks.zh: 4.1 一般场景

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method on 23 23 scenes from three diverse datasets – Mip-NeRF 360, Shelly and Fuzzy dataset.
Mip-NeRF 360 [ 2 ] is the standard benchmark for unbounded scenes, with five outdoor and four indoor scenes.
Shelly [ 36 ] contains six synthetic objects with fur, wool, and thin leaves.
The very recently introduced Fuzzy dataset [ 34 ] contains eight captured objects with fibrous surfaces, such as cactus spines, fur, and brush bristles.
We follow the standard evaluation protocol of each dataset.
On Mip-NeRF 360, we downsample the indoor scenes by a factor of two and the outdoor scenes by a factor of four, and we hold out every eighth image for testing [ 13 ] .
On Fuzzy, we downsample the images by a factor of four and likewise hold out every eighth view for testing.
On Shelly, we train and evaluate on images of 1920 × 1080 1920{\times}1080 pixels with a white background.
The released Shelly train/test split mistakenly contains test cameras that also appear in the training set.
We therefore remove from the training set all images that coincide with a test image.
blocks.zh:
我们从3个不同的数据集——Mip-NERF 360,Shelly和Fuzzy数据集,对23个场景评价我们的方法.
Mip-NERF 360 [2]是无界场景的标准基准,有5个室外场景和4个室内场景.
雪莉[36]包含6个合成物体,有毛,羊毛,以及细叶.
最近推出的Fuzzy数据集 [34] 包含了八个有纤维表面的俘获物体,如仙人掌脊椎,毛皮,和刷毛的毛细毛.
我们遵循每个数据集的标准评价协议。
在Mip-NERF 360上,我们以2倍的系数对室内场景进行采样,室外场景以4倍的系数进行采样,我们按每八幅图像进行测试[13].
在Fuzzy上,我们用四分之一的系数对图像进行采样,同样将八分之一的视线进行测试。
在雪莉岛上,我们用1920×1080 1920\times}1080像素的图像来训练和评价 白色背景。
发行的Shelly列车/测试分裂错误地包含了同样出现在训练集中的测试摄像头.
因此,我们从训练中除去所有与测试图像相吻合的图像。

blocks.en:
We train for 30k iterations on all datasets, except for the outdoor scenes of Mip-NeRF 360, which, following Spherical Voronoi (SV) [ 29 ] , we train for 20k iterations.
MCMC relocation [ 14 ] stops 5k iterations before the end of training, and polyline merging ( Sec. 3.6 ) runs only after relocation stops.
We cap the number of primitives at 500k on Shelly and Fuzzy, and at the per-scene budgets of Spherical Voronoi on Mip-NeRF 360.
All our models use the Spherical Voronoi appearance model with eight sites (SV8) [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
除了Mip-NERF 360的室外场景之外,我们在所有数据集上进行30k迭代的训练,在球形Voronoi(SV)[29]之后,我们进行20k迭代的训练.
MCMC搬迁[14]站 在培训结束前进行5k次迭代,多线合并(3.6sec.)只在搬迁停止后才进行。
我们把原始人的数量限制在雪利岛和富兹岛的500k上,把球形Voronii岛的人均预算限制在Mip-NERF 360上。
我们所有的模型都使用有8个站点(SV8)的球形沃罗诺伊外观模型[29].

blocks.en:
We compare with two point-based methods that use the SV8 [ 29 ] appearance model: 3DGS-MCMC [ 14 ] + SV8 and Deformable Beta Splatting (DBS) [ 16 ] + SV8.
We also compare with Gaussian Frosting [ 8 ] and with the concurrent Line Primitives by Tojo et al. [34] , which optimizes opaque line primitives.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了使用SV8[29]外观模型的两种点基方法:3DGS-MCMC [14] + SV8和可变形的Beta Platting(DBS) [16] + SV8.
我们还比较了高斯冰冻[8] 和Tojo et al的并行线原生物. [34],它优化了不透明的线原始.

blocks.en:
On the test views, we report PSNR, SSIM [ 35 ] , and LPIPS [ 44 ] (with a VGG backbone).
We also report the FPS at test resolution, measured on an RTX 4090 GPU.
blocks.zh:
在测试视图上,我们报告PSNR,SSIM [35],和LPIPS [44] (带有VGG主干).
我们还以测试分辨率报告FPS,用RTX 4090 GPU测量.

blocks.en:
Our method with the Beta kernel outperforms all baselines on Mip-NeRF 360, and our method with the Gaussian kernel outperforms all baselines on Shelly and Fuzzy; see .
Our method also matches the frame rate of 3DGS-MCMC across all three datasets.
Since Line Primitives [ 34 ] rasterizes thin lines of constant width, it cannot model real-world scenes.
We provide qualitative video comparisons with the baselines on the project webpage in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Beta内核的方法超越了Mip-NERF 360上的所有基线,我们使用高斯内核的方法超越了Shelly和Fuzzy上的所有基线;见 。
我们的方法也符合3DGS-MCMC在所有三个数据集的帧率.
由于线首线[34]光栅化了不断宽度的细线,它不能模拟现实世界的场景.
我们在补充材料中提供了与项目网页基线的定性视频比较。

blocks.en: 4.2 Hair reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 头发重建

blocks.en:
For Hair reconstruction, we evaluate our method on a subset of GeomHair [ 15 ] .
GeomHair provides 400 strand-level hairstyles reconstructed from head scans, we select eight hairstyles that cover a wide range of hair length, curvature, and arrangement and place each hairstyle on the head mesh of GeomHair and render 100 views at 1200 × 800 1200\times 800 pixels from cameras around the head, path-traced in Blender with the hair shading model of Chiang et al. [5] .
We hold out every eighth view, which leaves 88 training and 12 test views.
We additionally evaluate on the challenging curly hair model of Yuksel [42] , which we render and split in the same way.
We report each metric as the average across the two datasets and show per-haircut breakdown in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
对于头发重建,我们评价我们的方法 子集GeomHair [15].
GeomHair提供从头部扫描中重建的400个线程级发型,我们选择了8个涵盖广泛发长,曲率,以及安排的发型,并在GeomHair头部网格上放置每个发型,并在1200×8001200\时从头部周围的摄像头中渲染出100个视图800像素,在Blender中用蒋等人的头发阴影模型追踪路径. [5] (中文(简体) ).
我们保留了每8个观点,这留下了88个培训和12个测试观点。
我们进一步评价了尤克塞尔具有挑战性的卷发模型[42],我们以同样的方式加以渲染和分裂。
我们以两个数据集的平均数报告每个计量标准,并显示补充材料的每条发条细目。

blocks.en:
We train for 30k iterations, following the same protocol as for the general scenes.
We compare against Gaussian Haircut [ 43 ] , which relies on hair-specific priors.
By default, they prune all Gaussians outside a sphere fitted to the hair, which removes the chin and neck on short hairstyles.
We enlarge this sphere to enclose the head mesh, so that both methods render the entire head.
blocks.zh:
我们训练30k的迭代,遵循与一般场景相同的规程.
我们比较了高斯海尔克特[43],它依赖于特定的发型前科.
默认情况下,它们会将所有高斯人排在一个配有头发的球体外,这可以将短发样式上的下巴和颈部去掉.
我们扩大这个范围 将头部网状, 这样两种方法 使整个头。

blocks.en:
We report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on the test views, rendered over a white background.
To evaluate the strand geometry, we compare our strands with the ground-truth strands of each hairstyle after resampling both at 0.5 mm.
Following Takimoto et al. [32] , a point in one strand set is considered correct if the other set contains a point within a distance threshold whose tangent line differs by less than an angle threshold.
We report the F1 score based on this criterion at the thresholds 2 mm and 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} , 3 mm and 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} , and 4 mm and 40 ∘ 40^{\circ} [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们报告PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS的测试视图, 由白色的背景。
为了评估线条几何,我们把线条与每条发型的地面真实线条进行比较,然后以0.5毫米的速度重新取样。
在Takimoto等人[32]之后,如果一个线组中的某一点包含在距离阈值内,其正切线差小于一个角度阈值,则一个线组中的某一点被认为是正确的。
根据这个标准,我们报告F1的分数为2毫米和20分,3毫米和30分,以及4毫米和40分。

blocks.en:
We show that our method outperforms Gaussian Haircut on all four metrics, with a 2.7 dB higher PSNR and a 14.3-point higher F1 score at 2 mm.
We show all the haircuts used in the supplementary material.
Like for the general scenes, we also provide qualitative video comparisons with the baselines on our project webpage.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,我们的方法在所有四个公尺上都超过了高斯海尔克特,一个2.7 dB更高的PSNR,一个14.3分的高F1的分数是2毫米.
我们显示补充材料中使用的所有发型。
同一般场景一样,我们还提供与项目网页基线的定性视频比较。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We ablate the main design choices of our method to measure the effect of each one.
Specifically, we test our densification strategies (midpoint splitting and MCMC-style segment cloning), polyline merging, and attraction regularization. summarizes the quantitative effect of each choice.
blocks.zh:
我们放弃我们方法的主要设计选择 来测量每个方法的效果
具体来说,我们测试密度战略(中间点分裂和MCMC式克隆)、多线合并和吸引正规化。 概述每项选择的量化效果。

blocks.en:
We assess the importance of midpoint splitting by removing it from the densification strategy and relying on segment cloning alone.
This slightly degrades performance, which shows that midpoint splitting contributes to training.
blocks.zh:
我们评估中点分裂的重要性,方法是将其从密度战略中删除,仅依靠部分克隆。
这略微降低了业绩,表明中点分数有助于培训。

blocks.en:
We assess segment cloning, following [ 14 ] , by disabling it and relying on midpoint splits alone.
This leads to a significant drop in reconstruction quality.
Without cloning, primitives cannot be effectively redistributed to regions that require short segments.
blocks.zh:
我们评估继[14]之后的局部克隆,方法是使其丧失功能,仅依靠中点分裂。
这导致重建质量大幅下降。
没有克隆,原始人就无法有效地重新分配给需要短片的区域。

blocks.en:
Next, we ablate the polyline merging strategy by disabling it during training.
This has no effect on the reconstruction metrics, since the representation can still model a connected polyline using many independent segments.
We can see this as the connected components become much smaller without merging, which leads to substantially less structural cohesiveness.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们通过在训练中解除多线合并策略。
这对重建指标没有影响,因为代表仍然可以使用许多独立的部分来模拟连接的多线。
我们可以看到这一点,因为相互联系的组件在不合并的情况下会变小得多,这导致结构凝聚力大大降低。

blocks.en:
We assess the attraction loss by disabling it during training.
This also has no direct effect on reconstruction quality.
However, it weakens polyline merging: without the attraction loss, strands are not encouraged to form a cohesive unit, which reduces the number of connected segments in a polyline.
blocks.zh:
我们通过在训练期间使其丧失能力来评估吸引力的损失。
这也对重建质量没有直接影响。
然而,它削弱了多线合并:不失去吸引力,不鼓励线条形成一个凝聚的单元,这减少了多线中连接部分的数量.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced a splatting representation formed by convolving finite segments with anisotropic kernels, with anisotropic point primitives recovered in the zero-length limit.
For Gaussian kernels, the contribution of a segment along a camera ray has a closed form, and the corresponding compositing rule allows connected segments to be rendered independently without changing the result under subdivision.
We also derived a screen-space approximation that supports compact profiles and renders at speeds comparable to point splatting.
The experiments show competitive image reconstruction and demonstrate that the same primitives can produce connected curves suitable for shading and simulation, while broader claims about automatically recovered topology require further evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了一种与无异性内核结合的有限段形成的电镀代表物,无异性点原始物在零长度限度内恢复。
对于高斯内核,一个片段沿相机射线的贡献具有闭合形式,相应的堆积规则允许连接的片段独立渲染,而不改变子分区下的结果.
我们还得出了一个屏幕-空间近似值,支持紧凑的剖面图,使速度与点镀相当.
实验显示有竞争力的图像重建,并表明同样的原始人可以产生适合阴影和模拟的连接曲线,而关于自动恢复的地形的更广泛的主张需要进一步评价.

blocks.en:
While our curvilinear primitives demonstrate a new capability, our representation also opens up many directions for future research.
Because high-frequency color requires high-frequency geometry, reproducing fine texture currently requires many short segments.
Combining the curvilinear primitives with learnable texture maps could reduce the number of primitives and improve the recovered geometry.
We have also not explored interpolating the kernel between the segment endpoints, which would extend our family of primitives to shapes such as cones, triangles, and trapezoids, and could further generalize the representation to surfaces.
Real hair reconstruction also remains challenging, and integrating learned hair priors more carefully is a promising direction.
Finally, it would be interesting to predict our representation with feedforward models, and to exploit the recovered curves to reverse engineer physical properties of the captured objects.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的科幻原始人表现出了一种新的能力,但我们的代表也为未来的研究开辟了许多方向。
由于高频颜色需要高频几何,复制精细的纹理目前需要许多短段.
用可学习的纹理图将曲霉素原始素与可学习的纹理图结合,可以减少原始素的数量,改善恢复的几何学.
我们还没有探索将内核插在段端点之间,这将把我们的原始生物家族扩展到锥形,三角形,夹角状等形状上,并且可以进一步将代表物概括到表面.
真正的发型重建也仍然具有挑战性,更仔细地整合学到的发型前科是一个很有希望的方向.
最后,用向导模型来预测我们的表现,并利用回收的曲线来逆向研究所捕获物体的物理特性,将是有意义的。
